reuse.why: Writes its own case-insensitive #fixed regex instead of using the tree's tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText, with its case-sensitive, whitespace/# delimited rules), and does not fold the rule into the existing per-action category query or NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES-style fragment.

duplication.why: The same fetch-fixed-ids plus has-check guard is pasted into five actions and a sixth variant in copyPreviousMonth, on top of the already repeated category queries.

placement.why: getFixedCategoryIds sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide skip rules, but tag recognition belongs with the shared tag helpers.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions plus a release note change.

maintainability.why: Each month-wide action now applies skip rules three different ways (SQL fragment, SQL hidden filter, JS id set), and #fixed matching can disagree with how tags are recognised elsewhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: FIXED_TAG regex in budget/actions.ts goes around the note-tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText).

disguised_duplication.where: Tag detection is reimplemented as a new regex with different delimiters and case rules instead of calling extractTagsFromText; copyPreviousMonth folds the fixed ids into its templatedIds set, a reshaped copy of the guard the other five sites spell out.

one_place.where: Which categories are fixed is decided once in getFixedCategoryIds, which every month-wide action calls, though each action repeats its own skip guard around it.
